# Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress

MAUI host: UseMvvmExpress, UseAuth, MauiMainThread, page lifecycle. Depends on Core.

NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress
Docs: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-mvvmexpress/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT
Version: 1.0.0

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+), net10.0-maccatalyst (15+), Windows (net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0 when packed on Windows; otherwise net10.0). Single-window.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress

Registration: `builder.UseMvvmExpress(o => o.UseNavigationPage().UseDialogs().UseAuth<LoginViewModel>())`. `UseShell()` is optional.

## Use this package when

- A MAUI Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst, or Windows app already uses Core ViewModels and needs the host dispatcher, lifecycle behavior, and `UseAuth`

## Do not use when

- The project is `net10.0` tests only — use Core + `AddMvvmExpress()` / `AddAuth<T>()`
- They need Shell/page navigation or alerts/toasts — add Navigation / Dialogs packages

## Alternatives

CommunityToolkit.Maui (behaviors), Prism.Maui (bootstrapper).
